hero.label: Careers at Neryva
hero.title: Build enterprise AI with real constraints.
hero.description: We are looking for researchers, engineers, and operators who care about rigorous work, clear thinking, and practical systems. Neryva is research-led, enterprise-focused, and selective about what it builds.

items.title: Technical Discipline
items.description: We value specific thinking, measurable behavior, and work that can withstand scrutiny.

items.title: Practical Delivery
items.description: Research matters when it improves systems people can actually deploy, operate, and trust.

items.title: Low Ego, High Standards
items.description: Good ideas win on merit. We care more about correctness, clarity, and execution than hierarchy or theatrics.

items.title: Constraint-Aware Work
items.description: Security, reliability, and operational reality shape the work from the start rather than being added later.
